entries.claim: The exact pinned direct Latin Mass body at lines 175–176 corroborates the complete 32-word Gradual as a derived digital witness. The same runtime section also contains the following Alleluia, excluded here; no inherited reference or expansion supplies this body.

The complete 32-word Gradual body has been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page, printed p. 467, leaf n548. The following Alleluia and the post-Septuagesima Tract are separate components. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
